verdict.rationale: Docs state Slate 'by default respects agent rules in the following order,' implying support for a project-level instructions file that sets coding standards/conventions, and its Skills system (markdown instruction packages, .claude/skills/ compatibility) reinforces this. However, the pack does not show the actual file name, precedence order, or example content of such a rules file, nor independent confirmation it works as described. Missing for 10: concrete example/name of the instructions file, full precedence list, and hands-on verification that the agent actually follows it.
